away.summary: The Lightning (12-4-2) are coming off an 8-3 win over Buffalo. Dennis Hildeby is projected to start after Andrei Vasilevskiy played Wednesday. Brayden Point and Erik Cernak are injured, while Emil Lilleberg and Gage Goncalves are scratched. Sam O'Reilly has been recalled and is projected in the lineup.

home.summary: The Blue Jackets (7-9-0) have Cam Talbot and Jet Greaves listed as goalies, with Greaves first in the projected lineup. Isac Lundestrom and Conor Garland are injured. Luca Del Bel Belluz and Erik Gudbranson are scratched, with Jake Christiansen replacing Gudbranson on defense.
